kxgne01.title: Aries vs Cancer: The Read Receipt Final
kxgne01.caption:
Aries buzzed so hard the buzzer left the building. Still lost round one.
The full game, read receipts to the final. Who in your chat replies in paragraphs?

kxgne02.title: Taurus vs Leo: The Label Round
kxgne02.caption:
One question at game night: "so... what are we?" Leo screamed. Taurus kept eating.
Two minutes of situationship, decided by double points. Which sign asks first?

kxgne03.title: Gemini vs Virgo: Overthinking Finals
kxgne03.caption:
Eight drafts open. Fourteen rereads. One loading bar stuck at 99%.
Gemini and Virgo overthink their way through a full game. Who's your 2 a.m. text decoder?

kxgne04.title: Libra vs Capricorn: The Dinner Question
kxgne04.caption:
The holiday table asked the question. Libra dropped a fork. Capricorn brought a five-year plan.
The full game ends in a tie, with pie. What's your answer to "seeing anyone?"

kxgne05.title: Scorpio vs Aquarius: The Ex Is Typing
kxgne05.caption:
Eight months of silence, then three little dots. Scorpio lunged. Aquarius pulled the plug.
A full game about missing someone and not dialing. Who keeps the hoodie?

kxgne06.title: Sagittarius vs Pisces: Crush Confession
kxgne06.caption:
Pisces cried on the buzzer before round one. Sagittarius cleared the podium mid-jump.
Crush night, start to final. Who in your friend group confesses first?

kxgne07.title: Leo vs Scorpio: Advice, Reversed
kxgne07.caption:
Every question tonight is advice they once gave a friend. Now it's their turn.
The full mirror round, from the ticker to the final. Who gives your group its best advice and ignores it?

kxgne08.title: Virgo vs Sagittarius: First Date Eve
kxgne08.caption:
Twenty-four hours until the first date. One has three backup tables. One has zero plans.
The full game, nerves included. Which one are you the night before?
